evidence: Interactive/time-varying promises in the public ask: live board within 15 s without reload and without closing the open card, wiping a typed note or moving the cursor (instruction.md para 3; hireops_rules.md:115-123 incl. 'how far they have scrolled'); conversation arrival while at newest vs scrolled up, earlier-message paging keeping place, drafts/cursor never touched, live unread counts and seen marks (instruction.md para 4; hireops_rules.md:142-175); refused move put back with focus on the card (rules:82-85); Enter/Shift+Enter compose; session end mid-draft. Theme switching and phone layout are explicitly NOT required (instruction.md para 6; visual/prompt.md:'Assess desktop craft at a conventional desktop viewport. No phone layout or theme switching is required'), so no resize/toggle exercise is owed. Each interactive promise has a criterion that tells the judge to act and wait rather than score a still paint: (1) functional/prompt.md protocol V: 'Without reloading or clicking in this page, wait up to 15 seconds (a wait-for call, or snapshots; accept what is present at the first snapshot at or after 15 seconds)' -> hro_live_board. (2) functional protocol U: 'Every reading in U is made without reloading, navigating or clicking in Rafael's page: wait up to 15 seconds after the other person acts' -> hro_unread_counts, hro_seen, hro_unread_scrolled_up (scroll up in Noor's thread, Noor sends from an independent context, read place/notice/count before and after going to it). (3) protocol T: watch Tomas's reply arrive on Rafael's open conversation without reload (hro_msg_exchange); type two-line message with Shift+Enter, send with Enter, read box and focus, reload (hro_msg_compose); draft across conversation switch, Board and reload (hro_drafts); bring in earlier pages repeatedly (hro_thread_earlier). (4) protocol L: refused full-Interview move through the UI, then 'focus is on that card's controls' graded via 'document.activeElement inside the card' (hro_refused_put_back). (5) polish/prompt.md:14: 'After that action do not reload, navigate, click or type in the observed page until the update has been seen or 15 seconds have passed. Read document.activeElement, field values and scroll offsets with page.evaluate'; hro_pol_live_board: open card, click into note box, type 'Call back on Fri', scroll page/board (add cards up to twelve if needed), other recruiter moves a different card, then check details open, exact note, activeElement, scroll not reset, 'typing more appends' (catches caret reset); hro_pol_live_thread: typed reply at newest, Noor sends, draft/focus/append and view stays at newest (public per rules:158 'if they are at the newest message, it is shown'); hro_pol_earlier_place: getBoundingClientRect().top before/after loading earlier; hro_pol_failed_send: route-abort or setOffline for exactly one send; hro_pol_session_resume: sign out in second tab then press Enter in first page. Both dimensions also say a missing update within 15 s makes preservation unprovable and the row 0, so a still/first-paint app cannot pass. Golden scripted observations (not a judge run) show the reference supports these paths: workspace.json results 17 'live board ... open card, note draft and focus kept' arrival_ms 810; 18 'arrival while reading keeps draft, focus and scroll and is not marked read until viewed'; 19 'seen receipt and unread badges update live'; 14 'full Interview put back with the reason and focus on the card'; reference uses EventSource /api/events (app.js:142) with focus hand-back (board.js:323-337, threads.js:37-63) and scroll anchoring (threads.js:167-171). Weak-app probes: an app that only updates on reload fails hro_live_board/hro_unread_counts/hro_seen/hro_msg_exchange; an app that re-renders the whole board (closing card, resetting scroll/caret) fails hro_pol_live_board; a thread that jumps to bottom on arrival fails hro_unread_scrolled_up; a 60 s poller fails the 15 s waits. Conforming-alternative probes: SSE, polling <15 s or sockets all pass (rules:123 and criteria are transport-neutral); window-vs-container scrolling is allowed in pol_live_board; drag is optional everywhere. Minor untested corners (Note-level, not defects for this row): draft/caret preservation while scrolled up in a thread and a board update while a conversation is open are not separately exercised; candidate-side status wording is checked after Rafael's moves but not required to change live; functional protocol U says 'read Rafael's place' without the polish prompt's explicit scroll-offset/page.evaluate method. RISK: no full configured judge run (claude-code + configured model) exists in the evidence index (its scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... and Oracle/target scores are absent'), so whether the judge actually performs the 15 s waits, scrolls and focus reads inside the 600/900/9000 s budgets is unmeasured; scripted golden duration is not judge behaviour.
